name: Events & Ticketing
pitch: Promoters, venues, festivals and meetups: a site that sells tiered tickets with a seat map, and a check-in page for the door.
brief: This is a live event. The site sells tickets in tiers ({{tiers}}) for {{date}} at {{venue}}. Pages: the event home with a countdown and the line-up or programme, Tickets with the seat map, a Venue and map page, and an FAQ. Make the ticket call to action impossible to miss.

asks.app: Ticketing: the tiers are {{tiers}} ({{currency}}), total capacity {{capacity}}. Each order stores the tier, the quantity, the buyer's name and email and a short unique order code. Selling stops when a tier is full. GET /api/availability returns the seats left per tier. The Tickets page shows the remaining seats per tier live. Checkout is a clearly labelled demo with a fake card (no real payment), or Stripe test mode when STRIPE_SECRET_KEY starts with sk_test_.

deliverables: Tiered ticketing with a seat map
QR check-in page for the door
